facts.name: execution_lines
facts.value: PR CI runs the existing full offline pytest suite on Windows and Linux; 00-06 adds no workflow and its real-tool runners are standalone host-runner CLIs never pytest-collected, rejecting before process creation if the pre-execution record, single-use host gate, or matching immutable run binding is absent or invalid. Before any real process Custodian resolves Candidate/Integration Candidate/tree, materializes/verifies the no-.git snapshot, delivers it as a read-only validation handoff to Host, and exposes it only as source tree usable by the Sandbox Agent child; then issues static record -> binding -> gate. Host may only read/inspect/verify the handoff plus all three and seven inputs, never Git/materialize/copy/transform/mutate/separate-source execute it, then provisions/verifies and writes separate observations. Host-only bootstrap/cutoff/selfcheck and controlled E2E require state root, Candidate SHA, source-tree digest, tool lock, tool record, host gate, and run binding.
facts.source: contract interfaces, AC-10, and verification command table

facts.name: git_authority_isolation
facts.value: Real execution requires a Git-Custodian-resolved/materialized/verified controlled source snapshot containing no .git file or directory whose source-tree digest exactly equals the Integration-Candidate tree digest, plus lower-privilege or OS-sandbox proof. Custodian delivers it as a read-only validation handoff to Host and exposes it only as source tree usable by the Sandbox Agent child. Host may only read/inspect/verify the handoff and has no Git, snapshot materialization, copy, transformation, mutation, or separate-source execution authority. Repository CI and the Git Custodian legitimately use controlled Git fixtures before any Agent child exists. Linked-worktree .git ACL/mode protection is rejected.
facts.source: contract AC-08, AC-09, required tests, and proposed-adr-0030

facts.name: network_truthfulness
facts.value: Offline dependency resolution and loopback success do not prove OS-level egress denial. Required hard network deny is UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME unless an OS-level block is demonstrated.
facts.source: contract AC-07 and stop conditions
